auth.brandDescription: The distraction-free reading companion. Discover timeless works, track real progress, capture annotations, and build your digital library.
auth.zeroPassword: Zero password needed. Instant secure access via your Google account.
auth.legalDisclaimer: By continuing, you agree to Booklon's terms and privacy policies.
auth.privacyPolicyContent1: Booklon respects your privacy. When you authenticate using Google OAuth, we only store your basic profile identity (name, email address, profile picture) and your application-specific reading data.
auth.privacyPolicyContent2: Your library, bookmarks, notes, reading progress, and goals are stored securely in your private Firestore database partitions protected by zero-trust security rules.
auth.privacyPolicyContent3: We do not sell, rent, or distribute your personal reading activity to any third party. You can export or delete all your data at any time from the Settings screen.
auth.termsOfServiceContent1: Welcome to Booklon. By using our platform, you agree to access book metadata and public-domain reading materials for personal, non-commercial reading purposes.
auth.termsOfServiceContent2: Booklon does not circumvent digital rights management or claim ownership of third-party copyrighted materials. Full text reading is provided strictly for works in the public domain or authorized previews.
auth.termsOfServiceContent3: You are responsible for keeping your Google account secure. Abusive behavior, automated scraping, or attempts to breach system security will result in immediate termination of access.
auth.helpAndFaqContent1: How do I track my reading progress? While reading any book in the reader, your progress and reading session duration are automatically saved to your cloud profile.
auth.helpAndFaqContent2: Can I read on multiple devices? Yes. Log in with your same Google account on any smartphone, tablet, or computer, and your personal shelf, notes, and streak sync instantly.
